up: From the ChEMBL database, for the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1040694', retrieve all activity records. For each activity, include the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard activity type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Do not filter by relation type, units, or any other criteria beyond the assay identifier. Return all matching rows.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1040694';
